name: waylix
description: Waylix by AIDotLix — free & offline maps, drive/walk navigation and crowd-sensed hazard intelligence on a platform-agnostic engine.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @waylix/engine && npm run build -w @waylix/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @waylix/engine && npm run typecheck -w @waylix/server && npm run typecheck -w @waylix/mobile
